headline: Live transfer rumors, news, updates on deadline day
description: We bring you the latest news, rumors, done deals and reaction throughout Europe's transfer deadline day, up to the Premier League window closing at 6 p.m. ET.

headline: Gabriel Jesus completes transfer to Barcelona from Arsenal
description: Barcelona have completed the signing of Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal, the two clubs confirmed on Tuesday.

headline: Honest Ahanor joins Crystal Palace on loan, will join Chelsea in 2027
description: Chelsea have agreed a deal to sign Atalanta defender Honest Ahanor, with the player set to move to Stamford Bridge in 2027.

headline: Crystal Palace swoop for Malick Fofana despite Sunderland talks - sources
description: Crystal Palace have made a late move to hijack Sunderland's move for Lyon star Malick Fofana and are optimistic of securing his signature, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Ibrahim Mbaye and Taylor Harwood-Bellis join Aston Villa
description: Aston Villa confirmed the signings of Ibrahim Mbaye and Taylor Harwood-Bellis on Transfer Deadline Day.

headline: Fabio Vieira joins Hamburg in permanent deal from Arsenal
description: Fabio Vieira has completed a permanent move to Bundesliga side Hamburg SV from Arsenal.
